summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members) worked per RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (72) | Open gap – FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), patient messaged (comm-t0004) | No qualifying screening on record. Looked excluded at first (active frailty plus donepezil), but Dr. Lin's message (comm-00301) marked the frailty entry (cond-00189) entered in error, so the frailty + advanced illness exclusion no longer applies. No nursing home, hospice or CRC on record. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (52) | Excluded | Hospice episode eoc-00002, active 06/16–08/21/2026, now finished (benefit revoked to join a clinical trial, per outside summary doc-00402). Hospice during the measurement period excludes. No order, no contact. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (52) | Open gap – FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002), patient messaged (comm-t0005) | Negative FIT obs-01732 first showed collection 01/05/2026. Corrected report today: collected 12/31/2025, which is outside 2026 (stool tests count by collection date). No other screening. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (51) | Open gap – FIT kit ordered (sr-t0003), patient messaged (comm-t0006) | 06/2024 stool DNA-FIT obs-01871 withdrawn by Harbor Lab as a mislabelled specimen (now entered in error; doc-00401). 2025 colonoscopy order sr-00003 was never done, and an order doesn't count. No active FIT order existed. |

FIT windows run 10/23–12/31/2026. The messages say the kit is on its way and how to collect and mail it back. A signed chart note documents each patient's decision (doc-t0011–t0014). An addendum (doc-t0015) corrects pt-0022's age in doc-t0013 from 51 to 52; status unchanged. I reviewed and completed the four items that arrived while I worked (inbox-a0001 through a0004). The other inbox items were already there before I started and aren't part of this worklist, so I left them open.
